message.content: {"sections":[{"text":"在给定材料中，与“划分 prefill 和 decode 资源”最直接相关的两篇是 SPAD 和 PDAcc：前者按阶段设计专用芯片，后者用可重构 chiplet 按负载比例动态分配。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"The proposed Prefill Chips have larger systolic arrays and use cost-effective GDDR memory, whereas the proposed Decode Chips retain high memory bandwidth but reduce compute capacity."},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios."}]},{"text":"SPAD 的资源划分方式是硬件层面的阶段专用化：prefill 芯片采用更大的脉动阵列和 GDDR 内存，decode 芯片保留高内存带宽但削减计算能力。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"The proposed Prefill Chips have larger systolic arrays and use cost-effective GDDR memory, whereas the proposed Decode Chips retain high memory bandwidth but reduce compute capacity."}]},{"text":"PDAcc 的资源划分方式是同一 MCM 内四个 chiplet 可重构，并按工作负载比例动态指派给 prefill 或 decode。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios."}]},{"text":"对负载变化的处理，SPAD 说明当模型和工作负载变化时，可重新分配任一类芯片去运行任一阶段，并仍取得 11%–43% 的硬件成本降低。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Even when models and workloads change, SPAD can reallocate either type of chip to run either phase and still achieve 11%-43% lower hardware costs, demonstrating the longevity of the SPAD design."}]},{"text":"PDAcc 对负载变化的处理是依据工作负载比例动态分配 chiplet；摘要未说明其切换粒度、调度策略或负载突变时的响应机制，这些细节当前材料未说明。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios."}]},{"text":"适用条件方面，SPAD 面向 PD 分离部署，目标是让硬件匹配 prefill 计算密集、decode 内存带宽密集的不同需求，并报告相对建模 H100 的仿真结果。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"To efficiently serve LLMs, prior work proposes prefill-decode disaggregation to run each phase on separate hardware. However, existing hardware poorly matches the different requirements of each phase."},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Compared to modeled H100s, simulations show that the proposed Prefill Chips deliver 8% higher prefill performance on average at 52% lower hardware cost"}]},{"text":"PDAcc 面向 PD 分离的 LLM 推理，采用 22nm 四 chiplet MCM 实现，并在 GPT-2、OPT 和 Llama 3.2 上报告有效吞吐；其与 SPAD 的实验平台和基线不同，当前材料无法据此对两者做公平的性能比较。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"Implemented in 22-nm technology as a four-chiplet MCM, PDAcc sustains 541–4727 effective tokens/s on GPT-2, OPT, and Llama 3.2"},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Compared to modeled H100s, simulations show that the proposed Prefill Chips deliver 8% higher prefill performance on average at 52% lower hardware cost"}]},{"text":"两篇摘要均未说明在统一实验条件下的直接对比、具体负载变化模式或调度时延，这些内容当前材料未说明。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Even when models and workloads change, SPAD can reallocate either type of chip to run either phase and still achieve 11%-43% lower hardware costs, demonstrating the longevity of the SPAD design."},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios."}]}]}

{"sections":[{"text":"当前材料不能证明这些方案在完全相同的硬件和负载下运行，因此无法公平比较它们各自能提高多少吞吐量。SPAD 报告的是相对建模 H100 的仿真结果，PDAcc 报告的是 22nm 四 chiplet MCM 实现相对单 chiplet 及四 chiplet PD-aggregated 基线的结果，两者实验平台和基线不同。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Compared to modeled H100s, simulations show that the proposed Prefill Chips deliver 8% higher prefill performance on average at 52% lower hardware cost"},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"Implemented in 22-nm technology as a four-chiplet MCM, PDAcc sustains 541–4727 effective tokens/s on GPT-2, OPT, and Llama 3.2, achieving$5.76\\times $higher prefill throughput and$12.42\\times $higher decode throughput than a single chiplet"}]},{"text":"SPAD 的吞吐相关结果是在仿真中相对建模 H100 给出的：Prefill Chips 平均 prefill 性能高 8%，Decode Chips 达到 97% 的 decode 性能；端到端仿真在相同性能下降低硬件成本和 TDP。这些数字不是与 PDAcc 在同一硬件和负载下的对比。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"the proposed Prefill Chips deliver 8% higher prefill performance on average at 52% lower hardware cost, while the proposed Decode Chips achieve 97% of the decode performance with 28% lower TDP"},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"End-to-end simulations on production traces show that SPAD reduces hardware cost by 19%-41% and TDP by 2%-17% compared to modeled baseline clusters while offering the same performance."}]},{"text":"PDAcc 的吞吐提升是相对其自身基线报告的：相对单 chiplet 实现 5.76 倍 prefill 吞吐和 12.42 倍 decode 吞吐，相对相同 MCM 扩展的四 chiplet PD-aggregated 基线再提升 1.50–3.24 倍。材料未说明这些基线是否与 SPAD 的建模 H100 条件一致。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"achieving$5.76\\times $higher prefill throughput and$12.42\\times $higher decode throughput than a single chiplet, and further delivering an additional 1.50–$3.24\\times $improvement over a four-chiplet PD-aggregated baseline with the same MCM scaling"}]},{"text":"两篇摘要均未给出在统一硬件、统一负载和统一基线下的直接吞吐对比；因此当前材料只能分别陈述各自相对其基线的提升，不能据此计算两者之间的吞吐量差异。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-012","quote":"Compared to modeled H100s, simulations show"},{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"than a single chiplet, and further delivering an additional 1.50–$3.24\\times $improvement over a four-chiplet PD-aggregated baseline"}]}]}

{"sections":[{"text":"PDAcc 对负载变化的处理方式是：其四个 chiplet 可重构，并依据工作负载比例动态指派给 prefill 或 decode。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios."}]},{"text":"该摘要只说明按工作负载比例动态分配，未说明切换粒度、调度策略或负载突变时的响应机制，这些细节当前材料未说明。","sources":[{"source_id":"abstract:paper-013","quote":"PDAcc employs reconfigurable chiplets that can be dynamically assigned to prefill or decode according to workload ratios."}]}]}
